### Identifier sweep (three tiers, all three run)

Primary identifier: **the `status` / `value` / `reason` expando on a thenable** (React's `Thenable` union; `trackUsedThenable`; `attachPromiseStatus`; `pendingThenable`).

- **PROBE 1 (declared, org-wide `manhunt`)** — `name="FulfilledThenable"` → 3 hits in 2 files (`react/packages/shared/ReactTypes.js`, `query/packages/query-core/src/thenable.ts`); `query=` fulltext → 50 hits. Sibling-package rule applied: the org-wide name sweep reached **all five** `ReactFlightClientConfigBundler*.js` adapters (ESM, Webpack, Turbopack, unbundled/Node, FB) — none of which import one another, so no fold reaches between them.
- **PROBE 2 (wired, `collateral_damage`)** — 7 seeds, all seven lenses on first calls, `dependencies` kept in every narrowing. The `types` lens on `ReactTypes.js` is what returned the adapter family and the devtools caches; no other lens reached them.
- **PROBE 3 (read, text tier)** — `shakedown` regex `status\s*=\s*['"](fulfilled|pending|rejected)` over `query/packages/` → uncapped, 2 files. `shakedown` was then budget-refused, so the text tier was continued with `the_receipts bulk_search` (same verbatim-bytes tier) across react (26 paths → 21 matched, 230 hits), query (20 → 6), router (15 → 7), db (10 → 8), plus a verbatim read of `jotai/src/react/useAtomValue.ts`.

**Verbatim ground for the verdict** — `jotai/src/react/useAtomValue.ts:11-53`:
```
const attachPromiseStatus = <T>(promise: PromiseLike<T> & {
    status?: 'pending' | 'fulfilled' | 'rejected'; value?: T; reason?: unknown }) => {
  if (!promise.status) { promise.status = 'pending'
    promise.then((v) => { promise.status = 'fulfilled'; promise.value = v },
                 (e) => { promise.status = 'rejected'; promise.reason = e }) } }
const use = React.use || (<T>(promise: …): T => {
    if (promise.status === 'pending') { throw promise } … })
```
and `query/packages/query-core/src/thenable.ts:12-19,53` — `interface Fulfilled { status:'fulfilled'; value:T }`, `interface Rejected { status:'rejected'; reason:unknown }`, `thenable.status = 'pending'`.
